Brendan.meaning: An English form of an Irish name; no clear meaning is recorded here.

Brogan.meaning: From an Irish name probably linked to a word for “shoe”.

Bronagh.meaning: An English form of the Irish name Brónach; no clear meaning is recorded here.

Clotilda.meaning: A Latin form of Clotilde; no clear meaning is recorded here.

Conley.meaning: An English form of an Irish surname; no clear meaning is recorded here.

Duane.meaning: An Irish name linked to dubh, meaning “dark”; it also has a surname origin.

Erin.meaning: From an Irish name for Ireland.

Floyd.meaning: An English form of the Welsh name Lloyd, meaning “grey”.

Henrietta.meaning: A Latin form of Henriette, related to Henry.

Irving.meaning: A Scottish surname name, probably linked to words meaning “fresh river”.

Keavy.meaning: An English form of Caoimhe, meaning “beautiful” or “precious”.

Maire.meaning: An English form of the Irish name Máire, related to Mary.

Melvin.meaning: From a Scottish surname; the source gives more than one possible origin.

Micheal.meaning: An Irish or Scottish Gaelic form of Michael.

Milos.meaning: A Slavic name; no clear literal meaning is recorded here.

Amiya.meaning: A form of Amiyah; in Hebrew, it means “my mother is Jah”.

Evan.meaning: Ultimately from a Hebrew name meaning “God is gracious”.
